vertical_margin_recovery.preconditions: origin mode off; horizontal-margin mode off; finite replay, not real-emulator compatibility
vertical_margin_recovery.timing_comparison: Both timed harnesses use default margins; extra Matea margin replay is a separate correctness regression, not a cross-module parity claim

color_frame_optimization.scope: correct explicit-color serializer baseline; warm logical palette caches; all four profiles are controls
color_frame_optimization.intermediate_regression: Cache-only version regressed truecolor/none p50 by roughly 8/9 percent; retained samples motivated direct level fast paths.

help_text_optimization.scope: Fresh unstyled strings. Capacity hints reduce growth allocations; additional zero-width cluster safety is included, so retain any timing regressions.

intermediate.finding: Unicode p50 regressed from 299.875 to 518.417 ns after a separate grapheme safety scan; final layout caches cell widths during the same scan and uses ASCII fast paths.

clock_format_optimization.scope: Fresh owned strings: fragmented Display/ToString before; bounded safe stack preparation and exact-size String after. Same visible output. Relative source timing regressions remain visible.

clock_performance_pending.active_update: Go Update arms a time.Timer and returns commands; Rust Update changes state and exposes a reusable schedule descriptor. These cannot be fairly compared as isolated pure state updates. Matched end-to-end scheduling/notification latency, cancellation and subscription construction remain pending.
clock_performance_pending.measured: Six fresh compact formatters and four paused/foreign guards; source setup timers drained outside measurements. No active-tick or module parity claim.
clock_performance_pending.allocation_bytes: Rust counts allocator-requested bytes; Go MemStats includes allocator rounding/tiny-object effects. Counts/bytes are not physical-memory equivalence.
